sources.name: Cinemeta — Movies & Series metadata
sources.capabilityNote: Stremio-compatible catalog/meta addon. Does not provide streams or downloads.

sources.name: TVMaze — Series metadata
sources.capabilityNote: Public metadata only. Anime and Korean drama are excluded; no video streams.

sources.name: TVMaze — Anime metadata
sources.capabilityNote: Anime-tagged or Japanese animation metadata only. No bundled anime streaming resolver.

sources.name: TVMaze — Korean drama metadata
sources.capabilityNote: Korean scripted drama only. Animation and other-language dramas are excluded; metadata only.

sources.name: IPTV-org — Public channel playlists
sources.capabilityNote: Public playlist descriptors. Individual channels may be offline or geo-restricted; availability is not guaranteed. Downloads disabled.

sources.name: MDN CC0 video sample
sources.capabilityNote: A clearly labelled CC0 sample video for native playback/download. Not a movie/episode resolver or missing-title fallback.
